title: Rooms Keys Label — payload
description: Set, change or remove the member's own personal label for one room they hold: its name, description, notes and tags, kept by their key holder for their eyes only. Each detail given replaces the stored one; a detail absent is unchanged; `removeX` removes one. At least one change is required (`minProperties` counts `roomId` and `member`; `ext` is not a change, which Recipient item 3 holds), and a detail cannot be both given and removed. Nothing here reaches the room, its host, its owner or a community. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

roomId.description: The room's identifier: its DID, as rooms/keys/list returns it.

member.description: The member whose label this is: the DID the room admitted, as rooms/keys/list 0.2 returns it beside the room. REQUIRED, never inferred, because a person holding one room as two personas keeps a label for each, and a label written under the wrong one is shown in the wrong context.

label.description: The member's new name for the room, replacing any they had. Absent: unchanged.

description.description: The member's new description, replacing any they had. Absent: unchanged.

notes.description: The member's new notes, replacing any they had. Absent: unchanged.

tags.description: The member's tags, replacing the whole set. Absent: unchanged. Remove every tag with `removeTags`.

removeLabel.description: Remove the member's name for the room. Only `true` is meaningful, so only `true` is accepted. A separate member rather than `label: null`, because a nullable optional member makes "unchanged" and "remove" the same value in libraries that map both to one absent option.

removeDescription.description: Remove the member's description. Only `true` is accepted.

removeNotes.description: Remove the member's notes. Only `true` is accepted.

removeTags.description: Remove every tag. Only `true` is accepted.

Response.title: Rooms Keys Label — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/keys/label. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/keys/label/0.1#response. The label as it now stands, and whether this request changed it.

personal.description: The label as it now stands. Absent when no detail remains: removing the last one removes the label.

changed.description: `false` when every value given already matched, and every detail named for removal was already absent: nothing was written and `updatedAt` did not move. A retried request answers `false`, which is what makes the task safe to repeat.
